versions.content: Error handling of peripheral access API If the Operating System detects an error (see [[SWS_Os_00806]]) while executing a ReadPeripheralX, WritePeripheralX and ModifyPeripheralX the OS shall return the ap- propriate StatusType and call the ErrorHook . Otherwise E_OK shall be returned.
